description: Drainage_Stormwater Management is a dataset listed in City of Edmonton open data portal (data.edmonton.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Edmonton. The location of stormwater management facilities (stormwater ponds/lakes) in Edmonton. NB: It is not safe to skate, sled, or walk on stormwater ponds. Please see for further information. Coverage: Edmonton. The portal files it under the category Externally Sourced Datasets. Its tags are stormwater, storm water management, drainage, epcor, lake. The table has 9 columns. Attribution on the portal: EPCOR. The portal shows 2026-06-05 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-edmonton-ca-portal.
